_comment: DEMO / MOCK DATA — NOT REAL GOVERNMENT SCHEMES. This dataset is fictional and created for demonstration purposes only. Do NOT treat these as real government schemes.

schemes.name: Community Enterprise Growth Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Financial assistance for SC/ST entrepreneurs in manufacturing, service, and food sectors.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme provides subsidized loans and mentorship support to entrepreneurs from Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities who wish to start or grow businesses in manufacturing, service, or food sectors. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and economic empowerment among marginalized communities.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: SC/ST entrepreneurs aged 18–60 with annual family income up to ₹5 lakh
benefits: Loan up to ₹10 lakh at subsidized interest rate
applicationProcess: Visit the nearest District Industries Centre (DIC)
Fill out the application form with required documents
Submit the business plan / project report
Application is reviewed by the district committee
Approved applicants receive loan disbursement within 45 days

schemes.name: Women Entrepreneur Empowerment Initiative
schemes.ministry: Demo Ministry of Women & Child Development (Fictional)
schemes.shortDescription: Dedicated support for women entrepreneurs in service, trading, tailoring, and food businesses.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme is designed to empower women entrepreneurs by providing affordable credit, business development support, and market linkages. It targets women who want to start or expand their businesses in service, trading, tailoring/textiles, or food sectors.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs aged 18–55 with annual family income up to ₹8 lakh
benefits: Loan up to ₹15 lakh at reduced interest rate
applicationProcess: Apply online through the demo portal or visit nearest DIC
Submit application with required documents
Attend a brief business readiness interview
Application reviewed within 30 days
Approved applicants receive disbursement and training schedule

schemes.name: Youth Startup Kickstart Programme
schemes.shortDescription: Support for young entrepreneurs aged 18–35 starting new businesses across all sectors.
schemes.description: This DEMO programme encourages youth entrepreneurship by providing seed funding, mentorship, and incubation support for new business ventures. It is open to all social categories and covers all business types.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Young entrepreneurs aged 18–35, all categories, starting new businesses
applicationProcess: Register on the demo startup portal
Submit detailed business plan online
Shortlisted candidates attend a pitch session
Selected applicants receive seed funding
Quarterly progress reviews for continued support

schemes.name: Rural Artisan & Agri-Business Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Support for rural entrepreneurs in agriculture, handicrafts, and food processing in selected states.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme supports rural entrepreneurs engaged in agriculture, handicrafts, and food processing businesses. It provides financial assistance, technical training, and market access to promote rural livelihoods in selected states.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Rural entrepreneurs in agriculture, handicrafts, and food sectors in select states
benefits: Loan up to ₹8 lakh at subsidized rate
Direct market linkage through government e-marketplace
applicationProcess: Visit the Block Development Office
Submit application with domicile and income proof
Field verification by block-level officer
Application reviewed by district committee
Approved applicants receive training followed by disbursement
schemes.stateCoverage: Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Assam

schemes.name: Business Expansion & Modernization Fund
schemes.shortDescription: Credit facility for existing businesses seeking expansion or modernization.
schemes.description: This DEMO fund helps existing micro and small enterprises modernize their operations, upgrade technology, or expand capacity. It provides term loans at competitive rates with flexible repayment options.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Existing business owners aged 21–60 with income up to ₹10 lakh
applicationProcess: Apply at the nearest MSME District Office or online portal
Submit business registration and financial documents
Site inspection by MSME officer
Loan sanctioned by bank in coordination with MSME office
Disbursement in phases based on project milestones

schemes.name: Minority Community Enterprise Support Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Financial and training support for minority community entrepreneurs in retail and trading.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme provides concessional credit and skill training to entrepreneurs from minority communities who want to set up or run small retail and trading businesses.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Minority community entrepreneurs aged 18–55 with income up to ₹6 lakh
benefits: Loan up to ₹8 lakh at subsidized rate
applicationProcess: Apply at the nearest Minority Welfare Office or online
Submit application with minority certificate and income proof
Attend a skill assessment session
Application reviewed by state minority commission
Approved applicants receive training followed by loan disbursement

schemes.name: Divyang Entrepreneur Assistance Programme
schemes.ministry: Demo Department of Empowerment of PwD (Fictional)
schemes.shortDescription: Comprehensive support for differently-abled entrepreneurs across all business types.
schemes.description: This DEMO programme offers financial assistance, assistive technology support, and accessible infrastructure grants to differently-abled entrepreneurs (Persons with Disabilities) who wish to start or expand their businesses.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Differently-abled entrepreneurs aged 18–55 with income up to ₹5 lakh
benefits: Loan up to ₹12 lakh at special subsidized rate
Assistive technology grant up to ₹1 lakh
applicationProcess: Register on the demo PwD entrepreneurship portal
Submit disability certificate and business plan
Accessibility assessment of proposed business location
Application reviewed by state disability commissioner
Approved applicants receive grants and loan disbursement

schemes.name: OBC Micro-Enterprise Development Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Micro-loan support for OBC entrepreneurs starting small businesses.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme provides micro-loans and hand-holding support to entrepreneurs from Other Backward Classes (OBC) who want to set up small-scale businesses with low capital requirements.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: OBC entrepreneurs aged 18–50 with income up to ₹3 lakh
benefits: Micro-loan up to ₹3 lakh at subsidized rate
Interest subsidy of 3% for first 2 years
applicationProcess: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Fill out the simplified application form
Submit OBC certificate and income proof
Application verified by block-level officer
Approved applicants receive micro-loan within 30 days

schemes.name: Urban Women Self-Help Enterprise Scheme
schemes.ministry: Demo Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (Fictional)
schemes.shortDescription: Support for urban women self-help groups in food processing and tailoring/textiles.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme provides financial and infrastructure support to women-led self-help groups in urban areas who are engaged in food processing, tailoring, textiles, and related micro-enterprises.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Urban women SHG members aged 21–50 with income up to ₹4 lakh
benefits: Group loan up to ₹6 lakh per SHG member
applicationProcess: SHG must register with the Urban Local Body
Submit group application through the ULB office
Attend group assessment and business viability review
Application reviewed by city-level NULM committee
Approved SHGs receive training and phased disbursement
schemes.stateCoverage: Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, West Bengal, Telangana, Kerala

schemes.name: General Low-Income Livelihood Scheme
schemes.shortDescription: Micro-credit for low-income individuals across all categories to start small livelihood activities.
schemes.description: This DEMO scheme provides micro-credit and basic training to low-income individuals from any social category who wish to start small-scale livelihood activities. It targets the most economically vulnerable sections.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Low-income individuals aged 18–58, all categories, annual income below ₹2 lakh
benefits: Interest subsidy of 5% for first year
Tool kit / equipment grant up to ₹25,000
Linkage with local market and buyers
applicationProcess: Visit the nearest employment exchange or CSC
Fill out the simplified application form
Submit income proof and identity documents
Brief interview by local employment officer
Approved applicants receive training and micro-credit within 45 days
